title: HPDG 808 1.1.0
notes: HPDG 808 1.1.0: Sound Library with search, filters and favorites; 35 section presets that change one tab and keep the rest; OSC B harmonics for small speakers; Draw Wave; LOAD REF + AUTO DRAW rebuilds a reference 808 as editable wave frames; SYNTH preview with PLAY and scrub; 12 new Trap / Drill voicings (212 presets). Projects and presets from 1.0 sound exactly as before.
